project_info.color_palette: Sky blue, white, green, red, tropical teal

main_subject.detail: A playful summer-safety infographic poster with the Toyota logo top left and the giant headline '3 LUU Y NHO GIUP XE AN TAM HON TRONG MUA NONG'. A white-and-green table in the middle compares 'TRANH' and 'NEN'. Under 'TRANH' the points are 'De bat lua / pin du phong trong xe', 'Cam sac dien thoai lien tuc khi khong can thiet', and 'Han che do xe duoi nang gat'. Under 'NEN' the points are 'Kiem tra xe dinh ky trong mua nang nong', 'Ngat cac thiet bi dien khong can thiet', and 'Che nang kinh lai neu do lau ngoai troi'. At the bottom sits a white Toyota Corolla Cross at a beach, humorously topped with cucumber slices on the windshield and a folded blanket on the roof. Bottom-right script says 'Move your world'.
main_subject.style: Friendly automotive infographic with a whimsical summer twist, combining practical text with a playful beach-car visual
